ns2:course.label: Contemporary Philosophy of Education
ns2:course.description: Analyzes exemplary current work in the field, covering a range of contrasting philosophical issues and approaches. The course goal is to provide familiarity with notable contemporary authors from a variety of perspectives. Same as EPOL 506. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
